instruction: What is Uxaoro?
output: Uxaoro is a social network created by fourtexec. You can post text and photos, share 24-hour stories, react and comment, repost, chat with friends in encrypted messages, make audio and video calls, join communities, follow people, earn and spend an in-app currency called UX, and unlock Premium features.

instruction: Who develops Uxaoro?
output: Uxaoro is developed by fourtexec.

instruction: Who is the developer of Uxaoro?
output: The developer of Uxaoro is fourtexec.

instruction: What can I do in Uxaoro?
output: In Uxaoro you can create a profile, post text and images, share stories that last 24 hours, like, comment, react and repost, add friends, join communities, send encrypted direct and group messages, make audio and video calls, gift and spend UX, buy Premium, and sign in to other apps with your Uxaoro account.

instruction: What devices can I use Uxaoro on?
output: Uxaoro is available as an Android app, as desktop apps for Windows, Linux and macOS, and as a web client in your browser.

instruction: Is Uxaoro free?
output: Yes, Uxaoro is free to use. There is an optional Premium tier that you can buy with the in-app currency UX.

instruction: How do I create an Uxaoro account?
output: Sign up with a username, an email and a password. Your display name starts as your username, and you can change it later in Edit profile.

instruction: How do I change my display name in Uxaoro?
output: Open Edit profile and change your display name there. It starts out as your username when you register.

instruction: How do I share my Uxaoro profile?
output: Your profile can be shared as a link using your @username.

instruction: What can I put on my Uxaoro profile?
output: Your Uxaoro profile can have an avatar, a cover image, a bio, a status and your city. It also shows your username, your display name and your presence.

instruction: How does the Uxaoro feed work?
output: The Uxaoro feed is ranked and mixes posts from your friends, from communities you are in, and recommendations for you.

instruction: What can I post in Uxaoro?
output: You can post text and images. Your posts can be liked, commented on, reacted to and reposted by other people.

instruction: What are reactions in Uxaoro?
output: Reactions in Uxaoro are emoji you add to a post or a message. They show up as little pill chips under the content, and there is a quick picker to choose one fast.

instruction: How do I like a post in Uxaoro?
output: Tap the like button, or simply double-tap the post.

instruction: Can I repost something in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can repost a post so it appears again in the feed for your friends.

instruction: Can I save a post for later in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can forward a post or a message to Saved Messages, which is a private chat with yourself.

instruction: What is Saved Messages in Uxaoro?
output: Saved Messages is a private chat with yourself in Uxaoro. Posts and messages you forward there are kept as ordinary encrypted messages.

instruction: What are Uxaoro stories?
output: Stories are photo posts in Uxaoro that stay visible for 24 hours. You can see stories from yourself and your friends.

instruction: How many stories can I post with Premium in Uxaoro?
output: With Uxaoro Premium you can post up to 40 stories per day.

instruction: How do friends work in Uxaoro?
output: You can send a friend request by username. The other person can accept or decline it, and you can unfriend later. Uxaoro also suggests people you might know.

instruction: What are communities in Uxaoro?
output: Communities are groups in Uxaoro with their own unique username. You can join and leave them, and members have roles such as owner, admin, moderator, editor and member. Communities can be shared with a link.

instruction: How many communities can I own with Premium in Uxaoro?
output: With Uxaoro Premium you can own up to 4000 communities.

instruction: How do messages work in Uxaoro?
output: Uxaoro has direct messages, which are named after the other person, and group chats with roles. You can read them offline, pin chats, mute them, unsend messages, keep drafts, see typing and read receipts, add reactions, search your chats, and join groups through invite links.

instruction: Are my messages in Uxaoro private?
output: Yes. Chats in Uxaoro are end-to-end encrypted, including photos, videos and audio you send in them. Only you and the people in the chat can read them. Posts, stories and avatars are public by design.

instruction: Can I move my encrypted chats to a new phone in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. Uxaoro backs up your encryption key protected by your account password, so signing in normally on a new device is enough to restore it. You can also back up, restore or delete the copy yourself in Settings, under Key backup.

instruction: Can I make calls in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. Uxaoro supports one-to-one audio and video calls. On Android you use the phone and camera icons in a direct message, and you will be asked for microphone and camera permission.

instruction: Can I see when someone was last online in Uxaoro?
output: Uxaoro shows online or last seen on profiles, in chat headers and in the chat list, and it updates live. You can control who sees this about you in your privacy settings.

instruction: How do I control who sees my online status in Uxaoro?
output: In Uxaoro privacy settings you have two switches: who can see when you are online, and who can see your last visit time. Each can be set to everyone, friends or nobody. People you have blocked never see either.

instruction: What is UX in Uxaoro?
output: UX is the in-app currency of Uxaoro. You can buy it, receive it as a gift from other people, and spend it on things like Premium. Admins can also grant or deduct it.

instruction: How do I get UX in Uxaoro?
output: You can buy UX in the Uxaoro Telegram bot, receive it as a gift from another user, or get it granted by an admin. UX is not earned for activity like joining communities or viewing posts.

instruction: How do I buy UX in Uxaoro?
output: You buy UX through the Uxaoro Telegram bot. Link your account from Wallet, then use the bot to buy. Payment is made in crypto.

instruction: How do I link Telegram to my Uxaoro account?
output: Open Wallet in Uxaoro and choose Link Telegram to get a code, then send that code to the Uxaoro Telegram bot. After that the bot can show your balance, sell you UX and tell you the current rate.

instruction: Can I send UX to a friend in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can gift any amount of UX to another user, with an optional message. Gifting is free and needs no reason.

instruction: Can I send more UX than I have in Uxaoro?
output: No. If you try to spend more UX than your balance, Uxaoro rejects it and tells you that you do not have enough UX.

instruction: Where can I see my UX balance and history in Uxaoro?
output: On the web and desktop clients, UX is in the navigation with your balance, buy, gift, link Telegram and history. On Android it is under You, in UX Wallet. You can also tap Gift UX on someone's profile.

instruction: What is Uxaoro Premium?
output: Uxaoro Premium is an optional paid tier you buy and renew with UX. It raises your limits, such as 40 stories per day and up to 4000 owned communities, and lets you customize your look with colors, glow, style, badge, theme and chat bubbles.

instruction: How do I buy Uxaoro Premium?
output: You buy and renew Uxaoro Premium with UX. On Android you can purchase the plan, see your status and set up your customization right in the app.

instruction: What can I customize with Uxaoro Premium?
output: With Uxaoro Premium you can customize color, glow, style, badge, theme and chat bubbles. Your customization is also shown publicly to other people.

instruction: What is a Developer Account in Uxaoro?
output: A Developer Account lets you build your own apps on top of Uxaoro. You confirm an email code and turn on two-factor authentication, then you get the Developer badge and can create projects.

instruction: How do I become a developer in Uxaoro?
output: In the web client open the Developer section or your settings. Request a six-digit email code, enter it, and enable two-factor authentication. Then you get the Developer badge and can create projects.

instruction: What is Uxaoro Account / Login with Uxaoro?
output: Login with Uxaoro lets you sign in to other apps using your Uxaoro account. You approve the app inside Uxaoro and it receives only your public profile, such as your id, username, display name and avatar. You can review and revoke apps you have granted access to.

instruction: How do I revoke an app's access in Uxaoro?
output: Open Developer, then Granted access, where you can see every app you have authorized and revoke the ones you no longer want to use your Uxaoro account.

instruction: Can I use Uxaoro in a browser?
output: Yes. Uxaoro has a web client in your browser with the same features as the app, including the feed, stories, friends, communities, encrypted chat, reactions, reposts, calls and settings.

instruction: What is Uxaoro's design like?
output: Uxaoro uses a liquid glass look: frosted cards with blur on a black or white background. It has double-tap to like, an image lightbox, relative timestamps and unread badges.

instruction: What settings can I change in Uxaoro?
output: In Uxaoro you can change the theme between system, light and dark, pick an accent color, choose whether to show adult content, mark your own account as adult, and see the app version. You can also change your API host if you are a developer.

instruction: Can I control what content I see in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. Uxaoro has a switch called Show adult content, which is off by default. While it is off, adult content is hidden from your feed, profiles, communities and stories. You can also mark your own account as adult, and accounts marked that way see adult content by default.

instruction: How do I mark my account as adult in Uxaoro?
output: In Settings there is a switch called My account is adult. Turn it on to mark your account, and turn it off to clear it again, unless the mark has been locked.

instruction: What privacy controls does Uxaoro have?
output: Uxaoro lets you control who can see when you are online, who can see your last visit time, your block list, whether you show adult content, whether your own account is marked adult, and whether you get alerts about new sign-ins.

instruction: How do I block someone in Uxaoro?
output: You can block a user from their profile. Blocked people cannot see your online status or last seen, and you manage your block list in settings.

instruction: Does Uxaoro tell me about new sign-ins?
output: Yes. Uxaoro records every sign-in with the device, IP and method, and shows it in Settings under Security activity. The first sign-in from a new device notifies you, and you can turn the alerts off while still keeping the log.

instruction: Where can I see my sign-in history in Uxaoro?
output: Open Settings and look at Security activity to see your sign-ins, newest first.

instruction: Does the Uxaoro Android app have a PIN lock?
output: Yes. The Android app can lock itself with a 4-digit PIN, asked on cold start and after a timeout you choose. You can also block screenshots and hide the app from the recents preview.

instruction: What is the Uxaoro Premium badge?
output: The Premium badge is part of Uxaoro Premium customization. You can set it up in the app along with your color, glow, style, theme and chat bubbles, and it is shown publicly on your profile.

instruction: How do I report someone in Uxaoro?
output: You can report a post or a user in Uxaoro. Reports go to the moderation team, who can review them and take action.

instruction: What happens if my account is banned in Uxaoro?
output: If your Uxaoro account is banned by the moderation team, you lose access to the platform.

instruction: Can I change my password in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can change your password in settings.

instruction: Does Uxaoro support two-factor authentication?
output: Yes. Uxaoro supports two-factor authentication, and it is required if you want a Developer Account.

instruction: Can I use Uxaoro on more than one device?
output: Yes. You can sign in on multiple devices, and your encrypted chats come with you through the password-protected key backup.

instruction: Can I delete a message in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can unsend a message in a chat. It disappears for you immediately and is removed from the conversation.

instruction: Can I pin a chat in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. You can pin and mute chats, and rename group chats.

instruction: Can I search my chats in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. Uxaoro lets you search inside your chats.

instruction: How do I join a group in Uxaoro?
output: Groups in Uxaoro can be joined through a shareable invite link. Admins of the group can also revoke a link.

instruction: What is the difference between a user, a moderator and an admin in Uxaoro?
output: A regular user has no control panel. A moderator can look after users, posts and reports. An admin has full access, including roles, server settings, communities and the audit log.

instruction: Who becomes the first admin in Uxaoro?
output: The first person to register becomes the admin of that Uxaoro instance.

instruction: Can I gift UX with a message in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. When you gift UX you can add an optional message, and the recipient gets a notification.

instruction: What happens if my Uxaoro update is required?
output: Most Uxaoro updates can be postponed or skipped. A required update shows a prompt that you cannot dismiss until it is installed, and it has no Later option.

instruction: Does Uxaoro update itself?
output: Yes. The Android and desktop clients can update themselves. On Android the app downloads the new version and opens the installer, and on desktop the app applies the new version and reloads.

instruction: Can I skip a Uxaoro update?
output: If the update is a normal one, you can postpone it with Later or skip that version. A required update cannot be skipped.

instruction: How do I roll back a desktop update in Uxaoro?
output: On desktop, open Settings, go to Updates, and choose Roll back website.

instruction: What is the Uxaoro Telegram bot for?
output: The Uxaoro Telegram bot is where you buy UX. You link your account first, then you can check your balance, buy UX and see the current rate.

instruction: Can I pay for UX with crypto in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. UX purchases in the Uxaoro Telegram bot are paid in crypto.

instruction: Does Uxaoro show relative timestamps?
output: Yes. Uxaoro shows relative timestamps, such as how long ago something was posted.

instruction: Does Uxaoro show unread badges?
output: Yes. Uxaoro shows unread badges so you can see what needs your attention.

instruction: Can I view images full size in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. Tapping an image opens a lightbox where you can view it larger.

instruction: Does Uxaoro autoplay stories?
output: Yes. Stories in Uxaoro autoplay in a loop, edge to edge.

instruction: What video controls does Uxaoro have?
output: Videos in Uxaoro have a buffering spinner, a replay button, and glass controls with a scrub bar, elapsed and total time, mute and fullscreen that hide while playing. You can double-tap to seek back or forward ten seconds, and fullscreen keeps your position and mute setting.

instruction: Does Uxaoro support offline reading?
output: Yes. Uxaoro lets you read your chats offline from the cache on your device or in your browser.

instruction: Can I use Uxaoro with a screen reader?
output: Uxaoro is built with standard Android and web components, which support screen readers and other accessibility tools on your device.

instruction: Is Uxaoro available in my language?
output: The Uxaoro interface is in English. Update notes are published in more than one language.

instruction: Can I earn UX by being active in Uxaoro?
output: No. UX is not earned for activity like joining communities or viewing posts. You get UX by buying it, receiving a gift, or an admin granting it to you.

instruction: What can I spend UX on in Uxaoro?
output: You spend UX on things like Uxaoro Premium. You can also gift UX to other people for free.

instruction: Does Uxaoro have a dark mode?
output: Yes. Uxaoro has a theme setting with system, light and dark, plus an accent color you can choose.

instruction: How do I change the theme in Uxaoro?
output: Open Settings and choose your theme — system, light or dark — and pick an accent color.

instruction: What is the Uxaoro Developer badge?
output: The Developer badge is shown on your Uxaoro profile once you have confirmed your email code and enabled two-factor authentication as a developer.

instruction: Can I build an app with Uxaoro login?

output: You can register more than one Uxaoro account, but each one is separate, with its own profile, chats and UX balance.

instruction: What happens to my chats if I log out of Uxaoro?
output: Your encrypted chats stay safe. When you sign back in, your key is restored from the password-protected backup, so your old messages remain readable.

instruction: Does Uxaoro work without an internet connection?

instruction: Can I hide my last seen in Uxaoro?

instruction: Can I delete my Uxaoro post?
output: Yes. You can delete your own posts, comments, messages and stories. They disappear for you right away.

output: The Control panel is the staff area in Uxaoro. It is available to moderators and admins, and admins have extra tools like roles, server settings and the audit log. Regular users do not have a Control panel.

instruction: Can a moderator ban an admin in Uxaoro?
output: No. A moderator can ban regular users only, not other moderators or admins.

instruction: Can a moderator grant roles in Uxaoro?
output: No. Only an admin can grant roles in Uxaoro.

instruction: Can an admin delete a community in Uxaoro?
output: Yes. An admin can delete a community in Uxaoro. Community owners can also manage their own communities.

output: If you need help with Uxaoro, use the report option in the app or contact the team through the developer channels listed on the Uxaoro site.

output: You can download Uxaoro from the official Uxaoro site. The Android app installs as an APK, the desktop apps come as installers for Windows, Linux and macOS, and there is a web client you can open in your browser.
